description: This file defines the InboundEmailTester class responsible for automating acceptance tests related to inbound email functionality in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for navigating email settings and creating bounce email accounts.

classes.name: InboundEmailTester
classes.description: A class extending AcceptanceTester to facilitate acceptance testing of inbound email features, including navigation and bounce email setup.

methods.name: gotoEmailSettings
methods.description: Navigates to the email settings page in the application.

methods.name: createBounceEmail
methods.description: Automates the process of creating a bounce email account within the acceptance testing framework.
